messages:
Lena M.: Kicking off CobaltRidge Dedicated rollout window for 2026-05-15 02:00 UTC. Need final ops + infra thumbs. We're pinning to rdlw-3.2-fp16. Docs: https://redwood.in/release/cobaltridge-2026-05-15

deploybot: Deploy request D-2412 created by Lena M. Target: dedicated/cobaltridge-prod. Canary plan: 3% (20m) -> 25% (10m) -> 60% (25m) -> full (gradual).
Runbook: https://redwood.in/runbooks/D-2412
```
monitors: p95, rate_5xx, user_errors
auto_hold: {rate_5xx: 0.4%, p95: 220ms}
rollback_to: rdlw-3.1-lts
warm_after_rollback: 15m
```

Ravi K.: Staging perf looks stable on fp16 quant. p95 170ms, cpu/gpu saturation low. Happy to greenlight canary if ops confirm no infra ops during window.

Joan H.: Ops can cover the window. One note: add a temporary trace sampling bump for the canary (20% -> 50%) to catch any regressions in parsing.

Omar N.: Agree with trace bump. I'll apply a read-only pin to the dedicated fleet to avoid rolling agents: `fleet.pin: rdlw-3.2-fp16`. Also confirm no KMS rotations or key rolls during 01:30-03:30 UTC.

Priya S.: I've checked the KMS calendar  clear. I'll send a short customer advisory to CobaltRidge (CS already looped). Also adding a known-issue blurb about subtle token alignment differences to the support doc.

Lena M.: Updated config:
```
release_id: D-2412
model_pin: "rdlw-3.2-fp16"
trace_sample_canary: 50%
kv_prewarm: true
expected_cost_change: "+1-3%"
```

deploybot: Canary started at 2026-05-15T02:00:00Z (canary cb-5012). Monitoring: p95, rate_5xx, user_errors, cost. Auto-hold thresholds active.

Ravi K.: Canary metrics: p95 178ms, rate_5xx 0.12%, user_errors 0.02%, cost +1.6%. No obvious regressions. Recommend proceed to 25%.

Joan H.: Rolling to 25% now. Ops on standby for traces and elevated sampling. Will keep tracing hooks open. :mag:

Omar N.: Reminder: if we see sustained p95 > 220ms for 7m OR rate_5xx > 0.4% for 5m we auto-hold. Manual rollback triggers: customer-facing errors > 0.8% or cost spike > 10%.

deploybot: Ramp to 25% complete. Next auto ramp in 10m.

Priya S.: CS flagged a single support ticket in staging with minor token mismatch, not customer-facing. Documented in release notes.

Lena M.: If rollback needed: immediate pin to rdlw-3.1-lts, kick cache warm for 15m, invalidate partial caches for affected tenants, notify CS + AM, then re-open traffic window. Rollback playbook attached to runbook.

deploybot: Canary finished. Metrics nominal. Ramping to 60% now (auto).

Ravi K.: At 60% still looking clean. p95 185ms, 5xx rate 0.18%, cost +1.9%. Holding 20m for observation before final ramp.

Joan H.: 20m observation passed, no traces indicating regressions. Proceed to full.

deploybot: Gradual to 100% complete at 2026-05-15T02:12:36Z. No auto-holds triggered.

Omar N.: Post-deploy checks: all dedicated nodes pinned, agent versions stable, no KMS activity. Backfilled traces show normal behavior.

Priya S.: Customer advisory sent and CS on standby for the next 24h. Added FAQ about token alignment and throttle surfaces.

Lena M.: Closing D-2412. Updating runbook with notes: trace sampling increased during canary, small cost uplift, no rollback. Thanks team! :tada:
